ids.description: The resolved element ids, for composition with other components.

disabled.description: Whether the field is disabled (including inherited fieldset disabled state).

valid.description: Committed validity: `null` until validation has run.

touched.description: Whether the control has been blurred at least once.

dirty.description: Whether the value differs from the initial value.

filled.description: Whether the control has a non-empty value.

validating.description: Whether an async validation is in flight.

validity.description: The committed validity snapshot, `null` until validation has run.

ariaDescribedby.description: The composed `aria-describedby`, for wiring custom controls.

validate.description: Runs validation now, surfacing `valueMissing` even on a pristine field.

clearErrors.description: Clears committed errors and returns validity to the pristine (unvalidated) state.

reset.description: Resets interaction state and validity to pristine.

getRootState.description: Returns the state of the root.

getLabelState.description: Returns the state of the label.

getControlState.description: Returns the state of the control (input, textarea, select, or a custom host).

getHelperTextState.description: Returns the state of the helper text.

getErrorTextState.description: Returns the state of the error text.

getIndicatorState.description: Returns the state of the indicator.

getValue.description: The current value of the field.

getErrorText.description: The first error message of the field, `null` if there is none.

getRootEl.description: The root element of the field.

getFormMachine.description: The machine of the form the field sits in, `undefined` outside of a form.

setRequired.description: Marks the field as required or optional.

setReadOnly.description: Makes the field read-only or editable.

addDependencyChangeListener.description: Calls `callback` whenever the value of a field named in the `listenTo` prop of this field changes. Returns a function that removes the listener again. For a field without `listenTo` it never fires, but the returned function is still safe to call.

name.description: The name of the field. It keys the field in its form and is what the field's value is read by.

defaultValue.description: The initial value, used while the DOM holds no control for this name yet.

listenTo.description: Names of sibling fields in the same form whose value changes this field reacts to.

ids.description: The ids of the elements. Useful for composition.

disabled.description: Whether the field is disabled. Also inherited from a surrounding native `<fieldset disabled>`.

invalid.description: Whether the field is invalid, regardless of computed validity. Use for app-level errors (e.g. server errors) the machine cannot compute itself.

dirty.description: Whether the field's value has been changed from its initial value. Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

touched.description: Whether the field has been touched. Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

validate.description: Custom validation, run against the value and the native validity snapshot. May return a promise; a newer validation run supersedes an in-flight one.

onValidityChange.description: Called when the committed validity changes.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-disabled: Present when the field is disabled, or it is inside a disabled fieldset.
Root.data-invalid: Present when the field is invalid: a native constraint failed, or `validate`, the form or the server reported an error.
Root.data-valid: Present when the field has been validated and passed.
Root.data-required: Present when the field is required.
Root.data-readonly: Present when the field is read-only.
Root.data-touched: Present once the user has left the field at least once.
Root.data-dirty: Present when the value differs from the one the field started with. It goes away again when the user reverts the edit.
Root.data-filled: Present when the field has a value.
Root.data-focus: Present when focus is inside the field.
